description: One neighbourhood in detail for a decision: local market (sales, turnover, leasehold share, £/m² medians, growth), the borough's official UK HPI (hpi: average price by type, 1/5/10-year change vs London: quote this for how prices moved), £/m² price trend, crime with its offence mix (topTypes, a busy-centre note), road/rail noise, nearby state schools with their standing Ofsted grade plus independent schools (schools.independent), planning rules (home: conservation, Article 4, listed buildings, broadband), council tax bands and a typical bill (councilTax), the IMD decile (deprivation), a ballpark price for a bedroom count and website links. Coming soon: until Close Knit opens to assistants this tool answers status coming-soon, no data.
